title: Enhancement of catalytic centres by RuO2 addition to CuFe2O4 cathode catalyst for rechargeable lithium–air batteries: influence of CO2 on Li–O2 battery performances
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2024, 8,5581-5594
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01202J, Paper
Sharafudeen Pamangadan C., Perumal Elumalai
Herein, the oxygen reduction reaction and oxygen evolution reaction (ORR/OER) kinetics of the inverse-spinel CuFe2O4 catalyst was enhanced via the addition of a very low quantity of RuO2, which powers an LED when used in Li–air and Li–CO2 batteries.
